headline: Huhtamaki India Limited: Action(s) taken or orders passed
sum: Action(s) taken or orders passed - Huhtamaki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Demand Notice issued by Assistant Engineer, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Planning and Development Authority approving grant of Occupancy Certificate…
detail: Action(s) taken or orders passed - Huhtamaki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Demand Notice issued by Assistant Engineer, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Planning and Development Authority approving grant of Occupancy Certificate subject to payment of penalty of Rs. 17,54,823/- in respect of part of the factory premises of the Company situated at Silvassa.
